context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 凌/善悪/風刺/訳す/散乱/内需/砦/ノミネート

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、敵を、絶対、凌駕する、絶対、戦略、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on wartime strategy was really impressive — the way you handled how enemies tried to surpass each other, so thorough.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Open and clear on her name. Slight pause before the compliment, like she's gathering the right words. Steady voice, genuine respect. Not effusive but genuinely moved by the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、善悪の境、絶対、曖昧、絶対、になっていく時代、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝、本気、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. In my paper I looked at how the line between good and evil became so blurred during wartime — it was deep research, and I'm really grateful for the opportunity to explore it.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Modest but not self-deprecating. Meets her teacher's eyes. Speaks with the precision of someone who has thought about this carefully. Small breath after 'blurred,' like she's still processing the weight of what she studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、政府を、絶対、風刺、絶対、ジャーナリスト、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、感心、絶対。
lines.en: And your handling of wartime journalism and government satire was remarkable — such a broad perspective. I was really impressed by that.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in attention. Voice carries genuine admiration without condescension. Slower pace on 'broad perspective,' letting the words land. Slight nod in the voice, like she's affirming something she noticed in Sakura.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、敵国の文献、絶対、訳す、絶対、活動、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on the work of translating enemy documents during wartime — it was such deep research, and I appreciate your encouragement.
lines.style: Steady and direct. Gratitude without embellishment. Each phrase deliberate, like she's honoring the teacher's recognition. Slight warmth on 'appreciate,' a moment of genuine connection beneath the formal academic register.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、家、絶対、散乱した、絶対、街、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、立派、絶対、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: You also tackled something harder — how entire neighborhoods were scattered and destroyed. That's painful history to sit with, and you handled it with real maturity.
lines.style: Slower, more careful tone. Softens on 'scattered and destroyed.' A beat of weight before 'painful history,' honoring the gravity. Voice carries both admiration and gentle acknowledgment of the emotional difficulty. Not rushing past the hard part.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、内需、絶対、激減、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、社会問題、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I explored what happened to the domestic economy during wartime — how demand collapsed — and the social problems that created. Thank you for letting me dig into that.
lines.style: Measured, composed. Voice carries the weight of economic collapse without drama. Speaks from knowledge, not emotion, but there's care underneath. Trailing slightly on the gratitude, like she means it deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、最後の砦、絶対、なった、絶対、地域、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you wrote about communities that became the last stronghold during the war — that took real insight to recognize.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. Voice slows on 'last stronghold,' honoring the significance. Thoughtful pause before 'took real insight.' Speaks with genuine recognition of something difficult understood well.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、平和賞、絶対、ノミネート、絶対、活動家、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Yes. I looked at activists who were nominated for peace prizes during wartime — their work and courage. I really appreciated your recognition of that.
lines.style: Direct and clear, but with quiet pride. No false modesty. Speaks of the activists with respect. Closes with genuine warmth on the gratitude, understated but sincere. Like she's quietly proud and genuinely thanking her teacher.
